label: HISTORICAL PAPER TEST · NOT REALIZED PNL

policy.execution: long-only paper grid; daily recenter; closed candles only

risk_exposure.exposure_model: paper position notional; no borrowed capital

onchain_evidence.note: No PancakeSwap orders were executed. A real trading record requires provider-owned testnet or mainnet transaction receipts.

limitations: This is a deterministic historical paper test, not live or realized trading performance.
The candle source is BNBUSDT reference-market data, not PancakeSwap execution data.
The evaluation was added after the historical window and is not a pre-committed forward record.
It excludes slippage, gas, liquidity impact, MEV and intra-candle path ordering.
A session win rate must not be interpreted as a future-return guarantee.
